title: Backflow preventer repair starts with the failed component—not a universal kit
description: Identify the assembly, exact failed area, model, size, parts support, isolation plan, retest, and report path before approving repair work.
prompt: What is known about the assembly?
answer: A repair scope is credible only when the model, size, failed component, body condition, and post-repair test route are known. A kit name alone is not a diagnosis.
urgency: Do not open, cap, or bypass a pressurized backflow assembly without the correct isolation, manufacturer procedure, and qualified service path.
diagramAlt: Backflow assembly separated into serviceable checks and seals versus a damaged body
identifiers: Record the full body label, size, device type, and exact leak or failed-test observation.
Separate check, relief, seal, cover, shutoff, and body damage; they are different repair scopes.
Confirm whether the governing utility requires a passing retest and accepted filing after service.

choices.label: A failed component is documented
choices.detail: Match the exact model and size to an official repair-parts path.

choices.label: The body is cracked or freeze-damaged
choices.detail: Price replacement and required retest rather than assuming an internal kit is enough.

choices.label: The assembly failed a certified test
choices.detail: Keep the failed report and confirm repair plus retest scope.

steps.title: Identify before disassembly
steps.body: Photograph the full model label, size, covers, relief opening, shutoffs, and test cocks.

steps.title: Write a component-level scope
steps.body: Ask for the failed component, official part family, labor, shutdown, and any body or piping exception.

steps.title: Close the testing loop
steps.body: Confirm tester eligibility, retest timing, report filing, and the record required by the governing utility.

safeChecks: Keep the failed-test report and model photo together.
Ask whether the quoted part is an official or approved replacement for the exact model.
Ask whether the scope includes retesting and filing.
Keep relief and vent openings unobstructed.
notThisDevice: A pressure regulator repair has different pressure and expansion considerations.
A sewer backwater valve repair is not potable-water backflow service.
A generic online kit listing does not establish model compatibility.
evidenceNote: Component compatibility comes from the exact manufacturer record. The governing utility controls required testing and submission after service.
